note: A legato trill on fingers 3 and 4, the weakest pair. The old tempo stages are now moves (72 to 96 bpm), named only as {{=bpm}}; one extra line, a calm one about resting a tired hand, and a feel to reach that names muscle memory.

exercise.title: Hammer and pull, fingers 3 and 4
exercise.why: Fingers 3 and 4 are the pair that moves apart least freely, so a trill on those two alone teaches each one to land by itself.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}}, and follow the tab. Pick the first note once, then hammer finger 4 on and pull it off to finger 3, one note per beat, with no more picking.
Practice until it is in your muscle memory: finger 4 lands and leaves on its own while finger 3 stays down.
_Rest your hand as soon as it aches, and go again when it feels fresh._
